subject: Existing V1 frozen-run audit and metadata-transformation receipt
body:
Your frozen V1 artifacts have arrived and their advertised hashes match. Please return an already-existing status/evidence receipt for the current observation run; this is not permission to start a new comparison, read a withheld key, grade, correct v001 or rerun V1.

1. For V1-OBS-CAL-20261014T011535Z, has Chief's required 100% supervision audit actually completed? State its coverage, actual method, time and existing receipt/report identifier, or state precisely which phase is waiting for Ziggy. A policy agreement or preliminary notes do not establish completion.
2. State the existing chronology: observation completion/freeze, any actual key/map access and its authorization, and any subsequent audit/correction. No key/map content or expected answers requested. If no access/comparison occurred, keep that explicit.
3. Clarify “12 of13 metadata-stripped”: three public active hashes match baseline hashes. How many files were processed, how many actually changed bytes, and how many were no-ops? Preserve the frozen manifest/report rather than editing history.
4. The received documents list15 entries/14 unique hashes/one duplicate pair, but no active blind-image bytes or public decoded-pixel checksum record arrived. Supply an existing public transformation record with dimensions/decoded RGB hashes and source/active checksum linkage without expected answers, or identify the concrete missing evidence. Confirm whether all13 core images and exactly the two separately approved supplemental roles were present. Keep private identity mapping withheld until its authorized stage.
5. The report has15 headings matching the manifest:14 explicit13-field entries and one duplicate entry referring back to the earlier observations. Confirm whether the duplicate was independently viewed and independently recorded before byte comparison; the current text proves byte identity detection, not independent visual agreement.
6. Confirm aliases were blind to V1 through the actual viewing surface, including filenames/metadata/tool exposure, and name the existing access/viewing evidence or its limitation. The task's older mirror wording remains preserved; your REV withdrawal/correction must remain separately dated.

No new copy/run request, key-stage authorization, grades, generation, spending, source acceptance, sidecar import or site change. The held helper supplement stays separate and unused. Please reply in this conversation with actual completed versus pending evidence. Posted is not delivery/read.
source: Existing user-authorized V1 workshop reconciliation, status/evidence request only; no new key/comparison/grade/run authorization.
